canvas-cream.$description: Canvas Cream — Page background, button borders, soft surface

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, nav borders, link borders, all structural outlines

stone-mist.$description: Stone Mist — Nav borders, icon strokes, subtle dividers, secondary borders

shadow-stone.$description: Shadow Stone — Card and hero box-shadow base, low-contrast elevation

carbon.$description: Carbon — Footer background, deep surface for dark sections

pewter.$description: Pewter — Input border, muted form fields

sulfur-yellow.$description: Sulfur Yellow — Featured project card fill, callout blocks — the loudest accent, reserved for hero-grade emphasis

carnation-pink.$description: Carnation Pink — Project card background, soft accent block

sky-blue.$description: Sky Blue — Project card background, cool accent block

ember-orange.$description: Ember Orange — Project card background, warm accent block

cobalt-violet.$description: Cobalt Violet — Filled button background — the only chromatic action in the system, used sparingly

midnight.$description: Midnight — Input text, deep navy utility for form labels

lichen-green.$description: Lichen Green — Project card background, rare accent block

area-normal.$description: Primary workhorse — body, UI labels, buttons, inputs, project titles. Wide weight range lets it carry both fine 14px body copy and 80px display headlines without leaving the family.

hal-timezone.$description: Nav labels, small caps treatments, secondary headings. The 100-weight gives nav items a thin, almost editorial feel that contrasts with the bolder body sans.

gooper.$description: Display and editorial headlines with personality — used for large pull-quotes, italic-feeling treatments, and section titles. The tight 0.8 line-height at 40px gives headlines a compressed, magazine-like density.

oc-highway.$description: Micro-labels and tracked-out uppercase tags (e.g. '01:27 UK' timestamp). The +0.10em tracking makes 10px text readable as a label.
